scientific_integrity: The proof is a complete induction. Its only literature inputs are the published quasi-injectivity of \(\tau\) and of every \(J_s^{(k)}\); the new step follows from \(\tau(xp^{r-1})=r\tau(x)\) for a fresh prime \(p\). No finite computation is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The closure theorem is directional: it concerns right composition by \(\tau^{(m)}\) and does not settle arbitrary compositions or the other five mixed families in Question 18. An equivalent elementary observation could exist in an unindexed source.
title: Right composition by divisor-function iterates preserves quasi-injectivity
